body: Minor release carrying the 41 commits since 3.0.1: the full-codebase review fixes (T-253..T-282), the follow-ups (T-286, T-287) and the dialog accessibility work (T-283). Protocol stays 3 — nothing on the wire an installed client misreads; the amount-digit cap is a validation tightening, answered as an ordinary 422. Server, web and Android all change.
title: Release 3.1.0
